summary: The Warshade Halls are the command nexus of the War‑Shade Expanse. Shadow commanders, corruption generals, and Discordian tacticians gather here to plot campaigns. The Shadow Crucible at the heart of the halls empowers War‑Shade forces with endless corruption.
history: Formed when War‑Shade commanders consolidated their forces.
Shadow Crucible was built to empower War‑Shade armies.
Discord generals used the halls as a tactical nexus.
Corruption generals infused the halls with Discord energy.
The Shadow Prime manifested as the living embodiment of War‑Shade command.
